reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and no redline or comment was proposed — consistent with expectations for a compliant finding.

The cited text supports the conclusion: Section 5.8.1 imposes the exclusivity/non-compete covenant on Harpoon (the counterparty/licensor), which runs in our favour and is expressly carved out of the rule's detection guidance; Section 7.1.2 confirms the asymmetry by qualifying only Harpoon's Exploit rights with 'its exclusivity obligations hereunder'.

No requirements-purchase, sole-supplier or third-party-procurement restriction on AbbVie appears in the cited paragraphs; Section 5.4 affirmatively preserves AbbVie's sole discretion to appoint third-party distributors, supporting the preferred position.
Deterministic check ('no requirements/sole-supplier obligation on Customer remains') passed, corroborating the assessment.
Rationale correctly identifies our party (AbbVie, as licensee/buyer-side) and does not over-flag counterparty-side exclusivity that benefits us.
